title: Amma's (Jan's) Cranberry Apple Stuff
description: A sweet-tart baked fruit casserole with apples, cranberries, and a buttery oat topping. Makes enough for an 8 x 11 baking dish.

steps.instruction: Place chopped apples and cranberries in a baking dish.
Sprinkle sugar evenly over the fruit.
In a medium bowl, mix melted butter, oats, brown sugar, flour, and pecans.
Spread the topping evenly over the fruit.
Bake for 1 hour, until the topping is golden and the fruit is tender.
